name: Explore Bharat Safar — Cloudflare Edge CDN Cache Ruleset
description: Tiered caching strategy for static assets, GIS TopoJSON, and dynamic API endpoints

rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path starts_with "/_next/static/" or http.request.uri.path starts_with "/static/" or http.request.uri.path ends_with ".woff2" or http.request.uri.path ends_with ".svg")
rules.description: Immutable Static Assets (1 Year TTL, Serve Stale on Error)
Sovereign GIS TopoJSON Vector Maps (30 Days Edge TTL)
Dynamic Aggregation Facets (5 Minutes Edge TTL with SWR)

rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path starts_with "/admin/" or http.request.uri.path starts_with "/village-admin/" or http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/v1/auth/" or http.request.uri.path starts_with "/checkout/")
rules.description: Strict No-Cache for Admin, Authentication, and Checkout Workflows
